name: ParametricNoise self-attention noise
plain: Runs one random-weight multi-head attention pass over the noise itself, with each latent pixel as a token and its channels as features, to give the noise spatial clumping. Queries and keys come from a low-passed copy of the pooled noise and values from the sharp pooled noise, so nearby tokens attend alike; the result is upsampled, lerped with the input by residual and renormalized. A guided mode instead scales or re-standardizes the noise inside a MASK (amplitude, local variance, or a Laplace heavy-tail remap). No model is involved; the projection weights are random from the seed.
math:
Symbols: x noise (B,C,H,W); P=avgpool_d(x) tokens; Ctx=N(upsample(avgpool_s(P))); W_q,W_k ~ N(0,1/C) of shape (heads,C,d_qk) from the seed; T temperature.
Q=Ctx·W_q, K=Ctx·W_k, V=P split by heads. Y=softmax(QKᵀ/(√d_qk·T))·V, upsampled to H×W.
out = N(lerp(x, Y, residual)).
Guided: amplitude x(1+g·m); variance lerp(x,(x−μ_m)/σ_m, g·m); distribution lerp(x, Laplace-remap(x), g·m).

props.params: attention_mode self|guided|self_then_guided, heads 4, temperature 1.0, downsample 2, residual 0.5, modulate amplitude, gain 1.0, feather 4
props.limits: errors if tokens after downsample exceed a fixed cap; raise downsample
